A few dozen real entries from the Kaikki English, Russian, Latin, Polish, German, Ancient Greek,
Sanskrit, Spanish, French and Italian dumps (2026-10-03), reduced to the fields the trainer reads,
for the end-to-end test. Spanish verb entries keep their clitic (`combined-form`) rows only for
`hacer`. `russian-ru.jsonl` holds four entries of the Russian Wiktionary's dump
(2026-10-02), for the test of reading another edition. They come from Wiktionary and are
licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (Wiktionary contributors, <https://en.wiktionary.org/>,
<https://ru.wiktionary.org/>).
